name: shopfront
title: Shopfront
character: The painted shop sign and the price board: saturated colour edge to edge, a fat slab name with a sign-writer's shade, awning stripes, round stamps and a live Open plate.
signature: The board: a bolted enamel price list with dot leaders, specials and sold-out marks, beside a hanging Open plate that pack.js works out from the real opening hours.
